title: 第531章 福地揭秘第530章 沫浅念来访
slug: 全球没功法的我自创功法
content_zh:
林道对沫浅念来此有些好奇，心中疑云未散，端着茶杯，问道：“太师父，这位人宗宗主突然造访，究竟所为何事？”
儒雅老人轻叹一声，目光中透着几分沧桑：“她不过是代故人送些旧物，算是了却一段陈年恩怨罢了。”
说着，他那温和的目光越过林道，落在正探头探脑的小悠朵身上，眼神变得深邃：“这孩子，便是江海市邪教徒作乱的目标吧？”
这小丫头被保护得太好了，哪怕是他这等境界当面探查，也只能感觉到她像是一团圣洁无瑕的光源，内里究竟藏着什么，竟是一概不知。
林道伸手轻轻抚摸着小丫头的发顶，以示安抚，随后点头道：“嗯，她乃圣光之体。我找到她时，已被那邪教徒用秘法强行‘升维’成了天使。
见她失去记忆孤苦无依，我便收在身旁，认作妹妹，取名林悠朵。”
当着悠朵的面，关于那位疯狂牧师的具体恶行，林道只是一笔带过，不愿勾起小丫头任何可能的不好回忆。
“来，悠朵，叫太爷爷。”
小悠朵眨巴着大眼睛，定定地看着这位儒雅老人，随即展颜一笑，脸上绽放出温软人心的圣光，奶声奶气道：“太爷爷，好！”
“好！好！好！”
儒雅老人连道三声好，脸上浮现出难得的动容。
他这一生，亲人皆化尘土，好不容易收了两个徒弟，也都心野非要出去闯荡，至今生死未卜。
如今幸有徒孙作陪，膝下又多了个粉雕玉琢的太孙女，顿感这老天爷终究也没太苛待他。
平复了一下心情，儒雅老人神色变得认真起来：“西洲圣光教向来神秘且实力非凡。
若这丫头真是天使尊位，那你便要做好万全的准备。
天使在圣光教众心中，可是圣光之主在人间的代行者。
那群狂热的教徒一旦知晓，便会不择手段将这丫头带走，甚至不惜发动战争。”
林道微微颔首，沉声道：“太师父，我本意是想将她安置在晨曦学府，由您来看护一段时间。
可见到学府如今的状况，这里似乎也是一团乱麻。
灵气复苏是否已从学府内部开始？

升起防御阵法，可是为了防止外界势力的窥探？”
“差不多吧。”
儒雅老人放下茶杯，缓缓道：“灵气率先在学府内复苏，这并非最重要之事。
江海市本就是灵源之地，而晨曦学府占据灵源之地的核心，这件事，很多宗门大族皆是知晓。
但有老夫坐镇，他们不敢起别样的心思。”
林道隐隐有所猜测，试探着问道：“莫非，晨曦学府升起防御阵法，是另有目的？”
儒雅老人招手让小悠朵在身旁坐下，抬眼瞅着林道，没好气道：“你小子就别在这打哑谜了。
青帝渡劫时，难道就没收到关于‘福地’的信息？”
林道闻言，猛地抬头，眼神惊愕地看向老人。关于福地之事，竟被太师父这般精准说出，让他感到不可思议。
“呵！很惊讶么？”
儒雅老人见林道这般惊愕，脸上露出莞尔的笑容，摇头道：“老夫困居江海几十年之久，这里的任何风吹草动，如何能逃过老头子的感知。”
说到这，他停顿片刻，眼神变得深邃而幽远，沉声道：“整个江海市将升格为‘福地’，各种高等灵地会依次呈现于此。
这件事不仅老夫知晓，估计黑衣卫与大夏盟那边，也都探到了一角真相，这才有江海超级坊市的成立。”
林道闻言，心中恍然大悟。
content_en:
Lin Dao was a little curious about Mo Qiannian's visit, and the doubts in his heart were still there. He held the teacup and asked, "Master, what is the reason for the sudden visit of the leader of the Human Sect?"
The elegant old man sighed softly, with a hint of vicissitudes of life in his eyes: "She is just sending some old things to an old friend to settle an old grudge."
As he spoke, his gentle eyes crossed the forest road and fell on Xiao Youduo, who was peeping his head. His eyes became deep: "Is this child the target of the Jianghai City cultists' rebellion?"
This little girl was so well protected that even if he were to inspect her face to face at his level, he could only feel that she was like a holy and flawless light source, and he had no idea what was hidden inside.
Lin Dao stretched out his hand and gently stroked the top of the little girl's hair to express comfort, then nodded and said: "Yes, she is the body of holy light. When I found her, the cultist had used a secret method to forcibly 'ascend' to become an angel.
Seeing that she had lost her memory and was helpless, I took her by my side, recognized her as my sister, and named her Lin Youduo. "
In front of Yuduo, Lin Dao only briefly mentioned the specific evil deeds of the crazy priest, not wanting to evoke any possible bad memories for the little girl.
"Come on, Yuduo, call Grandpa."
Xiao Yuduo blinked her big eyes and looked at the elegant old man intently. Then she smiled, with a gentle and heart-warming holy light on her face, and said in a sweet voice: "Great grandpa, okay!"
"Okay! Okay! Okay!"
The elegant old man said hello three times, and a rare expression of emotion appeared on his face.
In his life, all his relatives have turned into dust. He finally accepted two apprentices, but he still has ambitions to go out and make a living. His life and death are still uncertain.
Now, fortunately, he has his disciple and grandson as his companions, and he has a beautiful great-granddaughter under his knees. He suddenly feels that God is not too harsh on him after all.
After calming down, the elegant old man's expression became serious: "The Holy Light Sect of Xizhou has always been mysterious and has extraordinary strength.
If this girl really has the status of an angel, then you must be fully prepared.
Angels are the agents of the Lord of Holy Light in the world in the hearts of Holy Light followers.
Once the group of fanatical believers find out, they will use any means to take this girl away, even starting a war. "
Lin Dao nodded slightly and said in a deep voice: "Master, my original intention was to place her in Chenxi Academy and let you take care of her for a while.
It can be seen that the current situation of the school seems to be a mess.
Has the revival of spiritual energy begun within the academy?
Raise a defensive formation, but to prevent prying eyes from outside forces? "
"Almost."
The elegant old man put down his tea cup and said slowly: "The spiritual energy is the first to be revived in the academy. This is not the most important thing.
Jianghai City is originally the land of spiritual origin, and Chenxi Academy occupies the core of the spiritual origin. This fact is known to many sects.
But with the old man in charge, they didn't dare to think otherwise. "
Lin Dao had a vague guess and asked tentatively: "Could it be that Chenxi Academy raised the defensive formation for another purpose?"
The elegant old man waved to Xiao Yuduo to sit next to him, raised his eyes at Lin Dao, and said angrily: "You kid, please stop playing riddles here.
Didn't Qing Emperor receive any information about the 'Blessed Land' when he was going through the tribulation? "
When Lin Dao heard this, he suddenly raised his head and looked at the old man in shock. Regarding the matter of the blessed land, it was incredible for him to be told so accurately by the Grand Master.
"Ha! Are you surprised?"
Seeing Lin Dao's shock, the elegant old man smiled with a smile on his face, shook his head and said: "I have been trapped in Jianghai for decades. How can any disturbance here escape the old man's perception?"
Speaking of this, he paused for a moment, his eyes became deep and distant, and he said in a deep voice: "The entire Jianghai City will be upgraded to a 'blessed place', and various high-level spiritual places will appear here one after another.
Not only do I know about this matter, but it is estimated that the Black Guards and the Great Xia Alliance have also found out a little bit of the truth. Only then did Jianghai Super Square City become successful.stand. "
When Lin Dao heard this, he suddenly realized.
